source.dashboard: Tec Visual Vocabulary > Visual Vocabulary > Ranking
source.how: REST definition + instance JSON (setCurrentPanel on a guest instance) + rendered SVG colors, nothing saved

examples.title: Horizontal Bar Chart
examples.visualCues: one solid-color horizontal bar per item, sorted longest at the top

settings.sort: gsi.sorts = [[{ key: '4~<Revenue>~~~~1~4', isAsc: false }], []] (rows by Revenue, descending)

examples.title: Vertical Bar Chart
examples.visualCues: one solid-color column per item, sorted tallest on the left

settings.sort: gsi.sorts = [[], [{ key: '4~<Revenue>~~~~2~4', isAsc: false }]] (columns by Revenue, descending)

examples.title: Bubble Chart
examples.visualCues: dots of different sizes in three blues on two numeric axes, no axis numbers

settings.transparency: allShpFmt { shpFillTrans: 70, shpBdrThk: 0 }, per-element fmtOnComb shpFillTrans 80
settings.axes: xAxLbShw false, yAxLbShw false (titles shown, numbers hidden)
settings.note: same build as the Correlation page's bubble chart

examples.title: Dot Strip Plot
examples.visualCues: one labeled row per item, each with a few dots along a shared value axis, dots colored by a second attribute

settings.trick: no Y metric: Rows = Region gives one strip per region
settings.sort: gsi.sorts rows: { key: '4~<Revenue>~~~hFurniture~<Category>~1~4', isAsc: false } (by one element's value)
settings.transparency: allShpFmt { shpFillTrans: 30, shpBdrThk: 0 }, per-element fmtOnComb shpFillTrans 80

examples.title: Slope Chart
examples.visualCues: straight lines between exactly two x positions, one per item, colored by group

examples.title: Bump Chart
examples.visualCues: lines with dot markers that cross as items swap places; y-axis is small whole numbers with 1 at the top

settings.rankMetric: derived: Rank<ASC=False, BreakBy={[Order Date (Year)]}>(Revenue) * -1, aliased 'Revenue Rank' on the chart
settings.hideMinus: custom number format (nct 7) '#,##0; #,##0' so -2 shows as 2
settings.thresholds: value basis (ttp 7) on the rank metric: <-3 #A4CBE6, -3..-2 #80ADD9, -2..-1 #558DCC, >=-1 #2E78BB

commonFormatting.palette: blues: series #4E80F4; Category #1A6698 / #83B4D4 / #6FBEF2 (dashboard palette, no element overrides); rank bands #A4CBE6 #80ADD9 #558DCC #2E78BB
commonFormatting.page: free-form, light blue-gray background, RANKING heading in blue, title + one-line description above each chart, 3 x 2 grid

findings.modDefFillClr: the chart's single-series fill color (BGR). Likely the setting the Correlation scatter build needs for its sand dots (untested).
findings.sortKey: '4~<metricId>~~~~<axis>~4' for a metric sort on rows (1) or columns (2); '4~<metricId>~~~h<element>~<attrId>~<axis>~4' sorts by one element's value
findings.hideNegativeSign: custom number format '#,##0; #,##0' displays negatives without a sign. Should also hide the Deviation tornado's left-axis minus signs (untested).

helpers.sortByMetric(vizKey, metricId, asc, {axi: act sort, sorts [[{key:'4!<metric>!!!!<axis>', metricSortKey:'2', isAsc}]]; axis 1 rows, 2 columns. Sending [[],[sort]] fails (500).
helpers.keepOnly: visualization filter keeping two time values for a slope chart

buildFromCode.verified: 2026-11-10 on Shared Studio > Business Insurance Claims Analytics: 'zz Ranking Showcase v3' (My Reports) built in 6.3 s from the repo files unmodified. Sorts read back as [[4!<id>!!!!1!4]] and [[],[4!<id>!!!!2!4]] (same shape as the demo); an ascending-sort test put West first on both bars, so the sort is applied.
buildFromCode.notYet: Element sort (dot strip rows by one group's value) returns 500 on Studio 11.6 even with the demo's exact key; the build sorts rows by the total instead.
